name: @vellumai/windows
description: Electron wrapper for the Vellum Assistant Windows app.

scripts.dev:standalone: bun run install:all && concurrently --kill-others --names web,electron --prefix-colors blue,green "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron-only: bun install && bun run setup && electron-vite dev
scripts.build:web: cd ../web && bun install && bun run openapi-ts && bun run build && cd ../windows && mkdir -p resources && rm -rf resources/web-dist && cp -R ../web/dist resources/web-dist
scripts.pack: bun run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
